name: hud_ui_save_load_partition_entries_by_pivot
description: HudUiSaveLoadDialog::PartitionEntriesByPivot partitions save/load entries around a write-time pivot.
known_limits: Local VC5 COFF target hud_ui_save_load_sort_helpers covers 0x436580 but currently fails tier S with 2 unmasked mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x436580 validates fastcall begin in ECX, end in EDX, a 0x140-byte HudUiSaveLoadEntry by-value pivot stack argument, forward and backward IsNewerThan scans, 0x140-byte entry swaps, and the returned split pointer.
The native smoke verifies the returned split range and partition invariant: entries before the split are not older than the pivot, and entries at or after the split are not newer than the pivot.
